fn:create.cost: O(fields + schema bytes); at most 64 fields, 1..32 visible rows, maxBytes 1..4096 per value.
fn:create.failure: Schema/Id/Text; initial numeric input can be incomplete until validate.

fn:createWithRules.cost: O(fields + rules + schema bytes); at most 128 typed relations, validates referenced field kinds.

fn:dispatch.failure: InvalidText; rejected over-limit edits restore the view text and selection. Submit validates all fields.

fn:render.cost: O(visible fields); new logical view only, preserves model selection/focus and shows validation errors.
fn:render.failure: Bounds/Id; rowHeight 64..128, caller chooses enough height and publishes the returned view.

fn:setValue.failure: UnknownId/Text; validates input bounds before mutation, not its final typed value.

fn:toJson.failure: Required/Integer/Real/Range/Timestamp/Relation; readonly, returns typed values or the first error with field index.

fn:toSchemaValue.cost: validates form fields, then a shared schema, then calls one pure typed mapper. It never mutates the form.
fn:toSchemaValue.failure: SchemaSubmitError::Form(StdError), ::Schema(ValidationError), or ::Conversion(E); mapper runs only after both validations succeed.

fn:toValue.cost: runs form validation before one pure, explicit typed mapper; it separates validation and conversion failures.
fn:toValue.failure: SubmitError::Form(Required/Integer/Real/Range/Timestamp/Relation) or SubmitError::Conversion(E); mapper runs only after form validation succeeds.

fn:validate.cost: O(fields + relations + value bytes); stores field and relation errors without changing edited text.
